items.headline: America: Democrats House niyantran ki ore
items.detail: US media ke anumaanon ke mutabik Democrats House mein bahumat ki ore hain, jisse Trump ke agenda ko chunauti mil sakti hai; antim ginati abhi baaki hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — House aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: UN: ICJ ke liye paanch nyayadhish chune
items.detail: General Assembly aur Security Council ne nau saal ke karyakal ke liye paanch nyayadhish chune; unka karyakal 6 February 2027 se shuru hoga.
items.exam_angle: UN aur ICJ: International exams ke liye — ICJ nyayadhish chunav aur karyakal.

items.headline: South Carolina: Andrews ne Senate seat jeeti
items.detail: Pediatrician Annie Andrews ne Republican Darline Graham ko harakar 28 saal mein pehli baar Democrats ko South Carolina ki Senate seat dilayi.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Georgia: Bottoms pehli Black mahila governor
items.detail: Keisha Lance Bottoms ne Rick Jackson ko harakar Georgia ki pehli mahila governor banne ka itihas rach diya; ve America mein chuni gayi pehli Black mahila governor hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — governor chunav.

items.headline: Florida: Donalds pehle Black governor bane
items.detail: Republican Byron Donalds ne Democrat David Jolly ko harakar Florida ke pehle Black governor banne ka itihas rach diya; ve DeSantis ki jagah lenge.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — governor chunav.

items.headline: North Carolina: Cooper ne Senate seat jeeti
items.detail: Poorv governor Roy Cooper ne Trump-samarthit Michael Whatley ko harakar Republican ke paas thi seat Democrats ko dilayi; yah Democrats ki pehli seat badli hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Greenland: America raksha samjhauta manzoor
items.detail: Greenland ki sansad ne 16-0 se, saat ke vote na dene ke saath, America-Denmark raksha samjhaute ko manzoori di, jisse do naye American adde ban sakenge; Denmark 19 November ko vote karega.
items.exam_angle: Arctic aur raksha samjhaute: International exams ke liye — Greenland, Denmark aur America.

items.headline: New Hampshire: Pappas Senate jeete
items.detail: Democrat Chris Pappas ne New Hampshire mein Republican John Sununu ko harakar khuli Senate seat apne dal ke paas rakhi; ve Senate ke liye chune gaye pehle khule taur par samlaingik purush honge.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: Georgia: Ossoff dobara Senate jeete
items.detail: Democrat Senator Jon Ossoff ne Georgia mein Republican Mike Collins ko harakar doosri baar jeet hasil ki; yah seat Senate par niyantran ki ladai mein Democrats ke liye aham mani ja rahi thi.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: America: Pehle natije, Warner jeete
items.detail: Virginia mein Democrat Senator Mark Warner dobara jeete; pehle polling band hone ke baad House aur Senate, dono ka niyantran abhi tay nahi hai.

items.headline: North Korea: America ko sakht jawab ki chetavni
items.detail: Kim Yo Jong ne KCNA bayan mein kaha America ki 'dushman neeti' par jawab aur sakht hoga; Binance choree ke FBI aarop ko kharij karte hue baatchit ki zaroorat par sawal uthaya.

items.headline: Europe: Bomb dhamki se saat udanein ruki
items.detail: Mangalvaar ko Warsaw, Sofia, Rome aur Murcia jaane wali kam se kam saat udanon aur Greece mein ek cruise jahaz ko dhamki mili; sab surakshit rahe, koi visfotak nahi mila aur kisi ne zimmedari nahi li.

items.headline: Trump: Saal ant tak Israel sahayata band
items.detail: Trump ne Fox News par kaha America saal ke ant tak Israel ko $4 billion ki saalana sahayata dena band kar dega, kyunki Israel ko ab iski zaroorat nahi hai; unhone kaha Netanyahu se is par sahmati bani hai, jabki $3.8 billion wala samjhauta 2028 tak tha.
items.exam_angle: America-Israel sambandh; videsh sahayata aur raksha samjhaute par sawal.

items.headline: Serbia: Alta Bank malik hirasat mein liya
items.detail: Somvaar ko Alta Bank ke malik Davor Macura ko 48 ghante ke liye hirasat mein liya gaya; aarop hai unhone bank ki tijori se lagbhag 45 arab dinar nikale, jabki shanivaar ko bank ka licence radd ho gaya tha.

items.headline: MINURSO band: 160 nirikshak wapas jayenge
items.detail: UN ne kaha Paschimi Sahara mein 35 saal purana MINURSO mission band hone ke baad 160 sainya nirikshak wapas bheje jayenge aur 13 kendra band honge; Suraksha Parishad mandate par sahmat nahi ho payi thi.
items.exam_angle: UN shanti mission; Suraksha Parishad mein veto aur mandate.

items.detail: High Court ne kaha teen adalaton ko galat jankari dene par bhi contempt karyavahi jan-hit mein nahi hai; MI5 pramukh ne gambhir kamiyon ke liye phir mafi mangi.
items.exam_angle: Khufia agency aur nyayik jawabdehi: International exams ke liye — MI5, contempt karyavahi aur adalat ki nigraani.
items.headline: MI5: Jhoothi gawahi par karyavahi nahi

items.detail: 4 November se wholesale diesel 1.20 rand/litre tak sasta hoga, petrol sirf 1 cent kam hoga; levy katauti ke bawjood mehenga crude aur kamzor rand ne raahat seemit rakhi.
items.exam_angle: Eendhan kar aur mudra: Economy exams ke liye — fuel levy, rand aur aayat par nirbharta.
items.headline: South Africa: Diesel sasta, petrol lagbhag wahi

items.detail: 132 mein se 109 sansadon ne sanshodhit budget ke khilaf vote diya; budget ko IMF ke naye karyakram ke liye zaroori mana ja raha tha.
items.exam_angle: Sansadiya vitt aur IMF: Economy exams ke liye — sanshodhit budget, IMF karyakram aur sarkar-sansad takraav.
items.headline: Senegal: Sansad ne sanshodhit budget kharij kiya

items.detail: Amirhossein Maleki aur Amirhossein Ebrahimi ko Isfahan mein chaar policekarmiyon ki maut ke mamle mein doshi thahraya gaya tha; Fars ke mutabik Supreme Court ne saza barkarar rakhi thi.
items.exam_angle: Manavadhikar aur dand: International exams ke liye — virodh, mrityudand aur nyayik prakriya.
items.headline: Iran: January virodh mamle mein do ko phansi

items.detail: People's Bank of China ne kaha 15 November se videshi mudra jama reserve ratio 4% se badhkar 6% hoga; ghoshna ke baad yuan 0.4% tak kamzor pada.
items.exam_angle: Mudra neeti aur videshi mudra: Economy exams ke liye — reserve ratio, yuan aur kendriya bank ke upay.
items.headline: China ne videshi mudra reserve ratio badhaya

items.detail: Raat bhar ke hamle mein bijli ghar aur substation nishana bane; Kyiv aur chhah kshetron mein aapatkaaleen bijli katauti lagi, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr aur Kharkiv mein sabse zyada asar hua.
items.exam_angle: Oorja suraksha aur yuddh: International exams ke liye — bijli buniyadi dhancha, aapatkaaleen prabandhan aur nagrik asar.
items.headline: Ukraine: 10 kshetron mein oorja par hamla

items.detail: UPDF ne kaha dwipakshiya samjhaute wale sainikon ki wapsi turant shuru ho gayi aur pehla dal ghar laut aaya; 2027 ke ant tak AUSSOM wale sainik bhi wapas honge.
items.exam_angle: Shanti mission aur sainik wapsi: International exams ke liye — AU mission, Al-Shabaab aur Somalia ki suraksha zimmedari.
items.headline: Uganda ne Somalia se sainik wapas bulaye

items.detail: Tsafe mein police kafile ki bus par hamle mein paanch policekarmi aur teen Community Protection Guard ke sadasya mare gaye; police ne paanch rifles chheen liye jaane ki baat kahi.
items.exam_angle: Aantarik suraksha: International exams ke liye — sashastr giroh, police kafila aur sthaniya suraksha dal.
items.headline: Nigeria: Zamfara mein ghaat, aath surakshak mare

items.detail: Berlin pahunchkar Zelenskyy ne kaha hawai raksha majboot karna aur oorja kshetra ko sahayata aaj ki baatchit ki prathamikta hogi; ve Merz, Steinmeier aur Bundestag adhyaksh se milenge aur Berlin Security Conference mein hissa lenge.
items.exam_angle: Kootneeti aur suraksha sahyog: International exams ke liye — Germany-Ukraine samarthan, hawai raksha aur oorja suraksha.
items.headline: Zelenskyy Berlin pahunche, hawai raksha baat
